major_cooldowns.name: Deathmark
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Cast it on cooldown once Garrote and Rupture are ticking and your Envenom buff is up, since it doubles Garrote, Rupture, and lethal poison damage and applies poisons twice.
major_cooldowns.id_note: 1248010 shares the name but was not observed; 360194 is the current cast id.

major_cooldowns.name: Kingsbane
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Cast it on cooldown immediately after Deathmark so the doubled lethal poison applications ramp its damage-over-time effect fastest.

major_cooldowns.name: Vanish
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Use it to enable Improved Garrote before your next Garrote, lining this up with Deathmark in most fights; in Mythic+ hold it instead for a restealth on a chain pull.

rule.action: Cast Kingsbane immediately after Deathmark so its ramping damage-over-time rides Deathmark's doubled lethal poison applications.

rule.description: Hold Vanish to line up with Deathmark
rule.action: Delay Vanish until Deathmark is close to ready so Improved Garrote's boosted Garrote lands inside the Deathmark window, unless you need an emergency restealth.
Open with Garrote, build to 5 combo points with Mutilate, apply Rupture, dump Envenom, then trigger Deathmark straight into Kingsbane.

rule.description: Envenom only at 5 or more combo points
rule.action: Only spend Envenom once you have 5 or more combo points; do not spend it early and waste combo points.

rule.description: Keep Garrote ticking on your target
rule.action: Refresh Garrote before it falls off; it is the first priority in every rotation.

rule.description: Keep Rupture ticking on your target
rule.action: Refresh Rupture at 5 or more combo points before it falls off your target.

rule.description: Fan of Knives on 2 or more targets
rule.action: Switch to Fan of Knives for combo points once 2 or more targets are up instead of your single-target generator.

rule.description: Crimson Tempest to spread bleeds in AoE
rule.action: Use Crimson Tempest to spread bleeds to secondary targets once several enemies are up, but watch the energy cost.
